test_name: Identification and Authentication - IA-3 Secondary Control Gap
architecture:
System: Secure-Analytics-071
Primary NIST family: Identification and Authentication (IA); evidence focus: IA-3.
Environment: AWS GovCloud. Network access uses PrivateLink; public ingress to managed data services is blocked. Transport uses TLS 1.3 and strict mTLS for service-to-service paths. Privileged administrators use hardware-backed MFA. Sensitive data and secrets are encrypted at rest with a KMS CMK. Control evidence: one workload certificate renewal job lacks an automated expiry alert though certificate authentication is enforced. The gap is documented as a secondary control deficiency; there is no plaintext transport, no public database exposure, no unencrypted administrator credential in S3, and privileged MFA remains enabled.
